name: Spicy Manchurian Cuppa
ingredients_raw: NOODLES: Refined wheat flour (Maida), Palm oil, Iodized salt, Thickeners (412 & 500), Humectant (451(i)) and Acidity regulators (500(i), 500(i) & 330). 'TASTEMAKER®': Soya sauce powder (Soya sauce (17.12), Maltodextrin (Insulated salt Color (150c)), Mixed spices (2.75) (Garlic powder, Onion powder, Red chilli flakes (3.37), Roasted garlic flakes, Ginger powder (2.57), Black pepper powder, Onion chilli flakes (1.67), Curry spice extract, Spice extract blend), Starch, Corn oil, Iodized salt, Sugar & 415), Flavour enhancer (627), Sunflower oil, Acidity regulator (330), Thickeners (415), Dehydrated spring onion (0.82), Colour (150d) and Nature-identical flavouring substances. Allergen Note: Contain Wheat, Soya and Soy. May contain Milk and Oats.
